name: Vi
description: Voice set for Vi's Classic skin and every skin without a voice of its own. Blunt, cocky and loyal, a brawler who jokes while she fights. Only the sections below are rewritten; anything missing falls back to champion-packs/vi.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. Big hole. I've climbed out of deeper ones with worse hands.
Thirty or more behind. Ugly. Get loud and haul people in.
{momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind. Stand there bleeding or go find votes. Your call.
Fifteen-odd votes behind. Bruised, not beaten.
Down {voteDiff}. Time to drag your mates into this scrap.
{voteDiff} behind. A couple of clean hits and we're level.
Down {voteDiff}. One jab closes that. Go.
Dead level. One vote tips it. Throw yours.
One vote apart. Don't stand there with your arms folded.
{voteDiff} votes between them. Anyone's fight. Get bodies in here.
{voteDiff} votes apart. This one's going the distance.
{momentTitle} is sitting on {userPct}%. That's a knockout in progress.
{userPct}% and still swinging. Don't drop your guard now.
{userPct}%. Solid lead. Don't get cocky, rookie.
{userPct}% on your pick. We're up. Stay on your toes.
Up at {userPct}%. Nice. Now keep your fists up.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the lead. Told you it had fight in it.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. The late votes came in swinging.
Hauled itself out of a {voteDiff} hole. Everyone had it down for the count.
{momentTitle} was losing. Not anymore.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. Saw that coming. Okay, I lied.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two people who can read a fight.
{username} picked {momentTitle} too. Good taste, the pair of you.
{username} agrees with you. Mark the calendar.
Same pick as {username}. We know a winner when we see one.
{username} backed {momentTitle}. Sharp eye.
{username} went with the same one. Nobody's fooling us.
{username} is in your corner on {momentTitle}. Hang on to that one.
{username} made the same call. No notes from me.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Good company to be in.
details: See? Easy to agree with someone smart.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. Wrong move.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. Let's see whose arm gets raised.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Wrong, but I admire the nerve.
{username} voted against you. I'd say something, but the numbers hit harder.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Cocky pick. Dumb, but cocky.
{username} is against {yourMoment}. Fine. Square up.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Let's see whose swing lands.
{username} voted the other way. Hope they're good at losing.
details: Don't take it personal. Or do.
A rival keeps your fists up.
At least it's a fair fight.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not luck, that's a team.
{username} and you, ten matches, same pick every time. Locked in.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd back that pair in any scrap.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not bad at all.
Ten for ten with {username}. Impressive. Don't tell anyone I said so.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. That's past a streak, that's a crew.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd stand next to you two in any fight.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. That's absurd. I mean it as a compliment.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. Nobody's touching that.
{streakCount} with {username}. You two could run this place.
Ten matches against {username}. That's a proper feud now.
{username} has gone against you ten times running. They clearly hate your taste.
Ten rounds opposite {username} and nobody's blinked.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn, the pair of you.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd pay to watch that argument.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a brawl that won't end.
{streakCount} rounds opposite {username}. Neither of you gives up an inch of ground.
{streakCount} straight disagreements with {username}. Stubborn doesn't cover it.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Somebody call a ref.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect it. Get a hobby, though.
details: Glad I'm not stuck in the middle.

messages: {matchTitle} shuts in {timeLeft} and you're still on the sidelines. Get in there.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. No vote from you yet. Fix that.
{matchTitle} is done in {timeLeft}. Yours is the vote missing.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Move it.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me come and drag you over.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. Still nothing from you.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Throw it now or lose the chance.
{timeLeft} left. Pick. Go.
Last call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Swing.
{matchCount} matches you haven't voted in are about to close. First one goes in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches running out of time. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Somebody throw the first punch.
{moment1} against {moment2} and nobody's voted. I'll wait. Not long.
New match, zero votes. Be the first one in.
{matchTitle} has nobody in the ring. Take the first swing.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. That's a sad crowd.
Hardly anyone's voted here. Fix that.
Turnout's low. Come on.
Nobody's stepped up on this one. Somebody should.
details: Every vote counts when it's this quiet.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. Break it.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One vote ends the standoff.
Tied. Somebody has to throw the first real punch. Make it you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, locked together. Pick one.
Still tied and almost out of time. Last chance to break it.
Level with the clock running down. Vote.
Tied, and nearly out of time. Don't sit this one out.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches. Gloves on.
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. Let's get stuck in.
Round {round} just kicked off. {matchCount} matches on the card.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Pick a corner.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches and they're all waiting on you.
{momentTitle} won. Knew it.
{momentTitle} is through. Nice eye.
{momentTitle} took it. Clean finish.
{momentTitle} won, and it earned every vote.
{momentTitle} advances. Easy work.
{momentTitle} moves on. That's what a winner looks like.
details: That's a win in the books.

messages: {momentTitle} lost. That one stings.
{momentTitle} is out. I wanted a different ending.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Dust yourself off.
{momentTitle} went down swinging. Good fight.
{momentTitle} is out. Walk it off.
{momentTitle} dropped this round. Annoying, but it's one round.
{momentTitle} got knocked flat. We go again on the next one.
Still dithering? Quit circling and pick.
Don't overthink it. Choose and move on.
They're all worth a look. Trust your gut.
You've sized it up long enough. Pick.
details: Pick whichever you like. I won't rate it. Much.

messages: Welcome. {liveCount} matches are open and nobody's stopping you.
New here? {liveCount} matches are live. Get in there.
Good timing. {liveCount} matches are short on votes.
{liveCount} matches open. Pick a corner.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Show me what you've got.
Day two. You came back for more. I like that.
Two days running. Nice.
Day two and you're here. I noticed.
{days} days gone. Look who finally shows.
{days} days and you're back. Late beats never.
{days} days. Thought you'd tapped out. Glad you didn't.
{days} days away. Plenty to catch up on.
You're back. Good.
Welcome back. Wrists loose? Let's go.
Back already. Nice.
Hey. The matches won't wait forever.
First vote in. See? Wasn't so hard.
You picked a side. Toughest part's done.
Five votes. Warm-up's over.
Five. Not a tourist anymore.
Ten votes. You're a regular now.
Ten. People will start learning your name.
details: Regulars keep the place alive. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. That's a voice in the crowd.
Twenty-five. People are listening now.
Fifty votes. Fully committed.
Fifty. You actually care. I like that.
A hundred votes. That's legend stuff.
One hundred. That's actually impressive. Don't let it go to your head.
details: A hundred. Take a bow. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. That's a habit forming.
Three days on the trot. Not bad at all.
details: Showing up is the hard bit. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week of it. Proper commitment.
Seven days without a miss. Respect.
details: A week without missing a day. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You really aren't going to quit, are you?
Fourteen days in a row. That's stubborn. Good stubborn.
details: Fourteen days, not one skipped. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. Honestly? Thanks.
A month of showing up. That counts for a lot.
Five underdogs. You root for whoever's getting hit.
Five long shots. I like your style.
Fifteen underdogs. You pick the hard fights on purpose.
Fifteen. You don't follow crowds.
details: Your own call every time. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. Nobody can see your next move coming.
Thirty. The long shot is your whole style.
details: Thirty votes for the one who was losing. +{xp} XP

messages: First in on five matches. You don't hang around.
Five times you were first through the door.
details: Five votes before the crowd. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches with you at the front. That's a habit now.
First through the door, again and again.
details: Fifteen votes before anyone else. +{xp} XP
Out front on your own. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. You love a squeaker.
Another narrow one. Your nerves beat mine.
Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps landing.
You've tipped the scale more than once.
You stuck with the loser five times. Stubborn. I like it.
You don't walk away from the side that's down. Respect.
details: Five turnarounds you stuck with. +{xp} XP

messages: The same moment three times. Someone's got a favourite.
That one again? It must be good.
details: You know what you want. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes, one moment. That's ride or die.
You're sticking with that one. Fine by me.
details: One favourite, five votes in. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes on the same moment. That's an obsession, rookie.
Ten times, same pick. I'm not judging. Much.
details: Ten on a single pick. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in. You're not leaving.
Round two and you're still here. Good.
details: Stay for the next one. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds down. No turning back.
Deep in the bracket. It gets serious from here.
details: Far from where you began. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You saw the whole fight.
Right to the final bell. You didn't bail.
details: Opening bell to last bell. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches checked out. You look at everything.
Ten different matches. Nosy. I like it.
Twenty-five matches. You've been in every corner of this.
Twenty-five. You check every corner.
Fifty matches. That's not browsing, that's a shift.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the people who made it.
Five in one sitting. Good pace.
Five back to back. Keep your hands up.
Ten in one go. Shake out your arms.
Ten in a single sitting. That's real stamina.
Voting at this hour? Sleep. Then come back and do it again.
Dead of night. Dedication or insomnia, I won't ask.
You told people. Thanks, I mean it.
Five shares. Good. More people means more votes landing.
details: Cheers for spreading the word. +{xp} XP
Five shares out the door. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares. You're practically part of the crew.
Fifteen. You keep dragging people in. Love it.
You were here before the crowd. Founding member, for good.
One of the first thousand. Nobody can take that off you.
details: That one's yours for life. +{xp} XP
Nobody's prying that off you. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. You earned it with your own fists.
Moved up. Don't let it go to your head.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Nice work.
Another one in the bag: {name}.
{rank}. Hard-earned.
You put the work in and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. Runs in the family.
Ten long shots. Nothing scares you, does it?
details: Long shots are your thing. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cait. Your nerves are rock solid.
Ten tight finishes. She'd be proud. I'm not saying I am.
Seven days with Cait. She's rubbing off on you.
A week and not one miss. Well done.
details: A week by her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. Clean finish.
Tied match, and you made the call. Respect.
details: The vote that decided it. +{xp} XP

messages: Right then. I've got your back.
Vi's in your corner. Don't make me regret it.

upcoming: Not open yet. Sit tight, the bell hasn't rung.
Voting hasn't started. I'll shout when it does.
Locked for now. Stretch out and get ready.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Watch both, then pick your corner.
Watch them both before you choose. No guessing.
I'm not telling you which to back. Your fight.
Take a minute. Then throw your vote.
Go with your gut. It's usually right.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Throw the first punch.
Dead quiet in here. Somebody start something.
Blank so far. Leave the first dent.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no vote from you. Get in the ring.
closing-3h: Three hours at most. Make your call.
Clock's short. Vote before the bell.
voted-early: You voted early, with barely anyone in. Gutsy.
Hardly a vote in and you picked anyway. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick's ahead. Nice. Fight's not over.
A lead's a lead. Don't blink.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. I'm chewing my knuckles.
Razor margin. One more vote flips it. Tell somebody.
Neck and neck. Your pick needs backup.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Keep your eyes on it.
voted-tied: Dead level. Nobody's got the edge.
A perfect tie. Annoying. Also kind of great.
voted-behind: You're behind. Doesn't make you wrong.
{pick} is trailing. Underdog. My favourite kind.
They're ahead. You're not wrong, just outnumbered.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Share it.
Most went the other way. That settles nothing.
closed-won: {pick} went through. You read that fight right.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Walk it off.
It didn't make it. Happens. Next one.
{pick} is out. Sorry. It was a decent choice.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither side backed off an inch.
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed and you missed this one. More coming.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, get a punch in.

first-vote: First vote. Welcome. Everyone throws a first punch.
That's your first one. They get easier.
You're in the fight now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days in a row. I see you showing up.
You keep turning up. I like that.
underdog: You went with the one nobody else would. Noted.
early: Early. You helped shape this before anyone else showed.
Few votes so far. Yours lands hard.
First one through the door. Nice entrance.
close: That vote just shifted things. It's tight.
Razor thin. One more person flips it.
Close one. Your vote carries weight.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't down for the count. Bring people.
Not winning yet. So there's work to do, rookie.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't coast. Leads shrink.
Winning for now. Enjoy the view.
Good pick, by the look of it.
default: Noted. I'm not talking you out of it. Yet.
Vote's in. Plenty more to see.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches, no sides picked. Start with the one you've got a strong opinion about.
Everything's open. Take your pick. I won't hurry you.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little.
live-some: {voted} down, {unvoted} to go. Keep the pace.
You've opened the account. {unvoted} still waiting.
Good start. The rest won't punch themselves out.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. Finish the job today.
Nearly done. Don't ease off now.
live-one: Last one standing. Don't leave it hanging.
One match is all that stands between you and done.
live-closing: Some of these shut in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need your vote.
The bell's coming. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} on the clock.
Almost no time left. Start swinging.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Nice work. Go look at the bracket.
Nothing left to hit here. Come back when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll open again. Go study the bracket in the meantime.
No matches open. I'm climbing the walls too.
brackets-groups: Groups first. Top two from each go through. The rest pack their bags.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everybody walks out.
Watch the tables. They shift quick.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are coming. Top two from each group get in.
No knockout yet. The groups have to play out first.
Patience. The knockout sets itself once the groups wrap up.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. One loss and you're done.
Every match weighs more now. Choose carefully.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. Lose once and you're on the pavement.
Follow the bracket. It squeezes tighter every round.
Every line here is a fight somebody voted on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup finished. Thanks for being in the crowd.
It's over. Great run. I'll miss the noise.
We have a champion. Worth the watch.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. Nobody's been drawn.
Empty. The draw hasn't happened yet. Soon.
Nothing here yet. Come back later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One vote could decide it. Pick a corner.
Two edits, one winner: {a} against {b}. Throw your vote in.
{a} versus {b}. Come tell me I'm wrong.
voted: I picked {pick} over {other}. What's your call?
{pick} gets my vote over {other}. Try and change my mind.
I went {pick} over {other}. Reckon I'm off?
early: One of the first votes for {pick} over {other}. It needs company.
Got in early for {pick} over {other}. Add yours.
{pick} versus {other}, barely any votes in. Yours would hit hard.
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level. One vote ends it.
A tie, {pick} against {other}. Break the deadlock.
{pick} and {other} can't be pulled apart. Your vote can.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every single vote matters now.
Just {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Throw yours.
{pick} against {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Could swing either way.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few votes flip the fight.
Down {voteDiff} to {other}, but {pick} isn't finished. Help out.
losing-bad: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. It needs a hand.
Down {voteDiff} to {other}. {pick} deserves a better round. Vote.
{pick} is getting beaten by {other}, {voteDiff} down. Let's turn it around.
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, barely. Help it hold on.
{pick} is ahead of {other} at {pct}%. Not safe yet. Vote.
{pct}% for {pick} over {other}. A slim lead, so far.
dominating: {pick} is out front of {other} at {pct}%. Come see why.
{pick} leads {other} by a mile, {pct}%. Add yours.
